They surveyed the spring, summer and autumn harvests. What of the winter harvest?

The audit checked the morning and afternoon shifts. What of the night shift?

So far we have met nobody from the village. What shall we do tonight?

notes: Thin evidence: one probe of this frame scored 0.88 ('… physical, mental and social sides of health. What of the spiritual side?'), a looser one 0.04, the last item of a colour list 0.23. All eight fire sentences share the 'What of the …' frame, so a hold would support the frame at least as much as the series reading. The + pole fires on list connectives (and, such as, including).
